scope.tracker: baseline_high_only with uniform role output filter

interpretation: the four switches previously induced by the task-frame-3 human annotation error are gone after QC-v2
all five remaining switches affect only GT identities 217 or 222 in the dense contact cluster
two switch events occur after observation gaps (2 and 11 frames), so extending track memory alone does not provide enough evidence to select the correct identity on reentry
the detector has an IoU>=0.5 box at every switch frame, so these five events are not explained by complete detector absence at the switch frame itself
task-frame-59 uses a detection barely above the high threshold (confidence 0.255492), making confidence/localization instability relevant even before considering appearance ReID
limits: this is diagnostic attribution of one baseline tracker and does not replace official TrackEval
the exact two_stage and ByteTrack QC-v2 outputs remain unavailable, so their corrected switch locations cannot yet be compared
tracker IDs are arbitrary and only continuity changes matter
